archetypes.name: telemetry
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds a new TSV ledger row type and JSON aggregation logic where schema, interval matching, and backwards compatibility are central.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the timing ledger and timing report changes for TSV schema consistency, JSON construction, interval matching, and backward compatibility with existing consumers. Pay close attention to column counts, sorting by round number, field sanitization, duration clamping, and cases where parent step marks are absent or repeated. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: handoff
archetypes.rationale: Implement and design handoff paths defer telemetry across wrapper boundaries, which creates integration risk around missed or duplicated round rows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace implement Step 5 and design Step 3 handoff/resume paths, including main-agent-vote-required, coder-main-agent-required, stall exits, lint/check loops, and starting-round re-marking. Verify round-start persistence, one-shot emission guards, and whether durations and counts are captured at the intended point without double-emitting. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: publish
archetypes.rationale: Design publish changes affect committed run-log freshness and stale artifact exclusion beyond ordinary local telemetry behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design log publishing and final timing-render changes for stale artifact cleanup, atomic JSON publication, stderr/failure sidecar exclusion, and ordering relative to design-log-publish and final-summary rendering. Check whether failure paths leave publishable stale timing-report-final artifacts or suppress necessary warnings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds many shell helpers and tests in a repository that explicitly targets Bash 3.2 and quiet best-effort behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new and modified shell code for Bash 3.2 portability, safe quoting, arithmetic on possibly empty values, subshell/environment behavior, and quiet best-effort failure handling. Pay particular attention to dynamically named guard variables, grep/jq fallbacks, tmpdir canonicalization, and warn-only telemetry calls. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
